Speaker: The Wanderer
When it's heard: Prologue: waking up in the forest
Effective line: ...Cold. Leaves in my mouth. Great start.

Speaker: The Wanderer
When it's heard: Prologue: waking up in the forest
Effective line: I reach for my name. Nothing. Not even the shape of one.

Speaker: The Wanderer
When it's heard: Prologue: waking up in the forest
Effective line: Two hands, one of them shaking. I'll start with the other one. ...And I'm not alone.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: The Forgotten Cave

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: A cold draft rises from the dark. It smells of old stone and older water. The stranger said the town is on the other side. Go in?

Speaker: The Rescuer
Effective line: Easy. Stay down. Hands like ice, pulse like a rabbit's. We'll fix that later.

Speaker: The Rescuer
Effective line: Keep your voice low. We are not the only ones in these woods tonight.

Speaker: The Wanderer
Effective line: I don't know this place. I don't know my own name. ...Who are you?

Speaker: The Rescuer
Effective line: A friend. That's all I can give you, and it's already more than is safe.

Speaker: The Rescuer
Effective line: Can you still fight, still draw on the Paths? Hold out your hand like you used to... never mind, just your hand.

Speaker: The Wanderer
Effective line: ...I feel them. All four, faintly. Like voices through a wall.

Speaker: The Rescuer
Effective line: Faint will do - it has to. Those torches on the ridge are looking for us.

Speaker: The Rescuer
Effective line: Tell me: which Path resonates the strongest within you?
Must keep (tested phrases): Tell me: which Path resonates the strongest within you?

Speaker: The Rescuer
Effective line: That one, then. Hold on to it, and it will hold on to you.

Speaker: The Rescuer
Effective line: Behind me is the Forgotten Cave. Follow it all the way through to {town}. Someone there will be waiting for you.
Must keep (tested phrases): The Forgotten Cave | Forgotten Cave | waiting for you

Speaker: The Rescuer
Effective line: Hear that? They're close. I'll draw them off the other way. They know my face; let them chase it.

Speaker: The Rescuer
Effective line: So you go on alone. Don't thank me. Thank me when you're somewhere with a roof. Go!

Speaker: The Wanderer
Effective line: ...Gone, toward the torches. I never even asked their name.

Speaker: The Wanderer
Effective line: The trees close up that way. The cave, then.
Earlier suggestion: The trees close up that way. The cave is up the worn path, north-east of the camp.  [why: Critic #1: six treeline stops and never found the arch; the stop line is the one place the game can name the direction (a beacon now marks the gate; this line backs it up)]

Speaker: The Wanderer
Effective line: No point getting lost twice in one day. Back to the cave.
Earlier suggestion: No point getting lost twice in one day. Back up the path to the cave - the glowing arch.  [why: Same; names the landmark the player can see]

Speaker: The Wanderer
Effective line: Whatever is waiting for me, it's through that cave.

Speaker: The Wanderer
Effective line: Torches that way, cave this way. I'll take the one that isn't looking for me.

Speaker: The Hollow Warden
Effective line: ...Hm. Woken. For this. Another of the little scavengers, I suppose.

Speaker: The Hollow Warden
Effective line: ...No. Not that. You smell familiar. Like old stone, and cold nights, in a house I used to keep.

Speaker: The Hollow Warden
Effective line: The house does not open for just anyone. ...Show me.

Speaker: (name card)
When it's heard: Boss intro before the battle with Hollow Warden: title under the name card
Effective line: Keeper of the House

Speaker: Hollow Warden
When it's heard: Boss intro before the battle with Hollow Warden: opening line
Effective line: ...You smell familiar. Show me your hands.

Speaker: (battle UI)
When it's heard: Mid-fight event "The Warden Stirs" vs Hollow Warden: event name
Effective line: The Warden Stirs

Speaker: (battle UI)
When it's heard: Mid-fight event "The Warden Stirs" vs Hollow Warden: what can happen (rule text)
Effective line: At half health the Warden wakes a little more: a 1/1 Cave Echo rises beside it.

Speaker: Hollow Warden
When it's heard: Mid-fight event "The Warden Stirs" vs Hollow Warden: the foe says it when the event fires
Effective line: ...You hit like someone I knew. Small. Stubborn.

Speaker: (battle UI)
When it's heard: Mid-fight event "The Warden Stirs" vs Hollow Warden: banner: what just happened
Effective line: A 1/1 Cave Echo rises beside the Warden.

Speaker: The Hollow Warden
Effective line: ...Yes. The old walls do not lie. The spring at the end ran once. You would not remember.

Speaker: The Hollow Warden
Effective line: Go. The house is yours to leave. Someone is waiting at the far end with a kettle on.

Speaker: Elder Maren
Effective line: So. You're the one they sent through the old tunnel. Kettle's been on since noon.

Speaker: Elder Maren
Effective line: I was told someone would come past the dry spring and that grumpy Warden. Nobody mentioned I'd need to wring them out.

Speaker: Elder Maren
Effective line: This isn't trust, dearie. You could be anyone's spy, and whoever pushed you into that tunnel is reckless. I don't like reckless.

Speaker: Elder Maren
Effective line: But a body in that state needs a bed, and I have far too much pie. Welcome to {town}. Questions later.

Speaker: The Wanderer
Effective line: ...I don't remember who I am. Not sure I'm worth the bed.

Speaker: Elder Maren
Effective line: Hm. Then we start with tea and pie and work up from there.

Speaker: Elder Maren
Effective line: First, get yourself known. Say hello to Sable, Tilly and Pip on the square, and buy a card from Sable. Then come back and knock.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: A narrow gap in the old treeline - easy to miss, easy enough to slip through, if you're not afraid of a shortcut.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: You wake in a forest clearing with leaves in your hair.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: A faint glow of four colors fades from your hand, like a thought you almost had.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: Beside you kneels someone hooded, very still, as if they have waited a long time.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
When it's heard: equipment vendor: first meeting / before the battle
Effective line: Security Protocol One: assess the customer's gait. Adequate - you may approach at your current level of walking.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
When it's heard: equipment vendor: first meeting / before the battle
Effective line: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant TO the Regional Merchant. The TO is load-bearing.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
When it's heard: equipment vendor: first meeting / before the battle
Effective line: Everything on this rack is inventoried and oiled under Security Protocol Seven. Protocol Seven is need-to-know. You do not need to know.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
When it's heard: equipment vendor: first meeting / before the battle
Effective line: Do not reach for the drawer. Its contents are classified, and so is your interest in them.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: A return customer strengthens the economy and my employee-of-the-month case file. Please look satisfied for the record.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: Fact: the beets came in early this year. The bear has been informed. We have an understanding. I do not ask why it is here.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (stage 0)
Effective line: Eat. Rest. Mind the questions you ask out loud, dearie. This town has ears.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (stage 0)
Effective line: And stop staring at my stick. Four little carvings in a ring, older than you, and none of your business.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (stage 1)
Effective line: You are warmer than you were. Don't mistake me, dearie, I am still watching you. The watching is free.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (stage 1)
Effective line: My pie recipe is pinned by the door, in my own hand. Round letters, careful loops. Copy it if you like. Smudge it and I will know.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (stage 2)
Effective line: Somebody in the square says you have a look of the old court about you. That is no prince, I told them. That is a damp young man with good posture.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (stage 2)
Effective line: And if you meet Wren in the Capital, tell her my pie is still the best thing in the kingdom. She'll argue. She'll be wrong.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (stage 3)
Effective line: I have told you the worst of me. The rest is easy, by comparison.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (stage 3)
Effective line: Go on, dearie, the next zone won't free itself. At my pace, we'd have to outlive the regime.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (stage 4)
Effective line: {prince}. I keep wanting to curtsy. My knees have voted against it.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (stage 4)
Effective line: Go on, the kingdom is waiting. The pie has less patience.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (known early)
Effective line: {prince}. {villain} let it slip to you, didn't he, that smug man. I had hoped to tell you myself.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (known early)
Effective line: Sit. When you are ready, the memories will come, and I will be here. With pie. Obviously.

Speaker: (narration/UI)
Effective line: {town}

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (first)
Effective line: Up and walking. Good. I am Elder Maren, dearie, and this is {town}, where the four Paths used to meet, and argue, and borrow each other's pans.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (first)
Effective line: Ten years ago {kingdom} was whole. Beefcakes made the energy, Gourmands fed us, Necrocrats minded the dead, Refusemancers hauled the waste and grew the crops.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (first)
Effective line: Then {villain} took the Paths, one by one, and set his rulers over them. Every road out of town has a gatekeeper now: a bridge, a barrier, a pantry door, a wall of thorns.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (first)
Effective line: Beat a gatekeeper and its road opens. Buy cards from Sable, fix your deck at the Deck Station, and come back to me for pie. Not answers. Pie.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (return)
Effective line: The roads are waiting, dearie: the Gainlands, the Buffet, the D.N.A. and the Dump. One zone at a time.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (return)
Effective line: You could still be anyone's spy. I have been wrong about people before. Once. In 1987.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (idle)
Effective line: Still here, dearie? The roads won't walk themselves. Well. Some of them would, if {villain} let them.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (idle)
Effective line: The pie on the sill is cooling, dearie. Unlike you, it knows when to wait.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (idle)
Effective line: If you're looking for advice: eat something. If you're looking for more advice: eat something else.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (idle)
Effective line: I've given you all the answers you need for now, dearie. Further questions require fieldwork.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (idle)
Effective line: Mind the fountain, dearie. People throw wishes in it. Most of them are mine.

Speaker: Elder Maren
When it's heard: Talking to Elder Maren in Crosspath (idle)
Effective line: Off you go, dearie; I'll be here. I'm dependable at a speed you can barely measure.

Speaker: Gatekeeper Brannoch
When it's heard: Talking to Gatekeeper Brannoch in Crosspath
Effective line: Hm. You came back. Wrote it in the notebook: 'came back.' Best two words I know.

Speaker: Gatekeeper Brannoch
When it's heard: Talking to Gatekeeper Brannoch in Crosspath
Effective line: Gate stays open. Always is. My girl's still up that road somewhere. In case.

Speaker: Gatekeeper Brannoch
When it's heard: Talking to Gatekeeper Brannoch in Crosspath (capital offer)
Effective line: Hm. That road. The Capital. You want to know why nobody comes back.

Speaker: Gatekeeper Brannoch
When it's heard: Talking to Gatekeeper Brannoch in Crosspath (capital offer)
Effective line: Four Paths kept that city alive. Beefcakes ran the lights, Gourmands the kitchens, Necrocrats the graveyards, Refusemancers the bins. {villain} chained all four.

Speaker: Gatekeeper Brannoch
When it's heard: Talking to Gatekeeper Brannoch in Crosspath (capital offer)
Effective line: So now it's Blackout, Famine, Restless Dead and Clutter up there. Dark streets, slow legs, no food that heals, rubbish in your deck.

Speaker: Gatekeeper Brannoch
When it's heard: Talking to Gatekeeper Brannoch in Crosspath (capital offer)
Effective line: You could walk in today. You would not walk far. Free the four zones: each one you free turns one service back on.

Speaker: Gatekeeper Brannoch
When it's heard: Talking to Gatekeeper Brannoch in Crosspath (capital offer)
Effective line: My girl Isla went up that road eight years ago. If you see her... tell her the gate is still open.

Speaker: Gatekeeper Brannoch
When it's heard: Talking to Gatekeeper Brannoch in Crosspath (capital active)
Effective line: Hm. Services still broken. Count them on the board by the road.

Speaker: Gatekeeper Brannoch
When it's heard: Talking to Gatekeeper Brannoch in Crosspath (capital active)
Effective line: Hm, each freed zone restores a service and makes the castle less frightening. My knees remain a local problem.

Speaker: Gatekeeper Brannoch
When it's heard: Talking to Gatekeeper Brannoch in Crosspath (capital done)
Effective line: Hm. All four zones free. The lights are on up there. I can see them from here.

Speaker: Gatekeeper Brannoch
When it's heard: Talking to Gatekeeper Brannoch in Crosspath (capital done)
Effective line: Go on. Knock on that castle door. Hard. And if you see Isla... I'm still watching the road.

Speaker: Sable
Effective line: Well met, {wanderer}. Sable, darling: seller of cards, and of very good stories about cards.

Speaker: Sable
Effective line: You start with plain neutral cards. The Paths are where the power is. Browse, buy, then put it all to work at the Deck Station.

Speaker: Sable
Effective line: Where do my cards come from? The past. Next question. My prices are fair, mostly. {villain}'s taxes are not.

Speaker: Sable
Effective line: Back, darling? The cards are honest; the misprints simply have a more adventurous relationship with spelling.

Speaker: Tilly Tonic
When it's heard: Talking to Tilly Tonic in Crosspath (first)
Effective line: Hi! Hello! You look like you need supplies! Tilly Tonic! I'm teal today, which means the new batch works!

Speaker: Tilly Tonic
When it's heard: Talking to Tilly Tonic in Crosspath (first)
Effective line: Everything here is one use in a fight! Equip what you buy on your Character screen, then use it on your turn!

Speaker: Tilly Tonic
When it's heard: Talking to Tilly Tonic in Crosspath (first)
Effective line: Probably not on yourself! Unless it's a healing one! I tested the healing one! I'm fine! I'm green! I'm usually green!

Speaker: Tilly Tonic
When it's heard: Talking to Tilly Tonic in Crosspath (return)
Effective line: Potions and charms, back for more! Equip them on your Character screen for fights - maybe skip the orange one until I stop matching it!

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: The door rattles. Something behind it is muttering about a receipt.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: Whatever it is, it is not open for business.

Speaker: The Store Room Ghosts
Effective line: OooOOOooo. Who disturbs the store room? We are VERY busy haunting it.

Speaker: The Store Room Ghosts
Effective line: Ninety years ago the three of us bought one lantern between us. It never worked. Tilly's great-grandmother said: no receipt, no refund.

Speaker: The Store Room Ghosts
Effective line: We waited, died, and kept waiting. Your haunting is very important to us.

Speaker: The Wanderer
Effective line: ...You're haunting a shop over a lantern.

Speaker: The Store Room Ghosts
Effective line: A FAULTY lantern. Four copper. With ninety years' interest, it is still four copper. We did the maths. We had time.

Speaker: The Store Room Ghosts
Effective line: Nobody comes in until it is refunded. Or until somebody beats us at cards. Everyone settles everything with cards round here.

Speaker: The Store Room Ghosts
Effective line: ...Fine. FINE. You play like someone who kept the receipt.

Speaker: The Store Room Ghosts
Effective line: We'll go. The chapel belfry has a lovely draught and nobody has complained about it in centuries.

Speaker: The Store Room Ghosts
Effective line: Tell Tilly the lantern's on the top shelf, still broken after ninety years of nightly checks. We were thorough, if poorly lit.

Speaker: The Store Room Ghosts
Effective line: Ha! No refund, no entry. Come back with a better deck. Or a receipt. Ideally both.

Speaker: (narration)
Effective line: Just shelves now. And one broken lantern on the top shelf, exactly where they said it would be.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
When it's heard: Talking to Bertram Beetsworth in Crosspath (too early)
Effective line: Halt. Equipment is issued on referral only. Security Protocol Two. Elder Maren does the referring.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
When it's heard: Talking to Bertram Beetsworth in Crosspath (too early)
Effective line: Bring Elder Maren's blessing. Better posture is appreciated but cannot be accepted in its place.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: Elder Maren sent you. I could tell from your gait. It says 'referred'. Congratulations: your file is now thick enough to be a file.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: Before I issue gear, protocol asks for exactly one thing: win a fight. Any fight. Any win counts. I will know.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: Fact: things roam the edges of town. The outskirts, round the lanes. They are rude and they are close.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: Beat one. Then come back and I will hand you something pointy.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: One fight won. That is the whole requirement. So far I count zero. I am very good at counting to zero.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: Security Protocol Four: check the outskirts. Enemies roam the edges of town. Any win counts.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: I will be here, guarding the drawer.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: One fight, won. Stamp. Stamp. Stamp. Three stamps is the correct number of stamps.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: Security Protocol Twelve: report to Elder Maren. She decides where things get pointed.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: Your Starter Blade. The first unit you play each battle hits a little harder. Do not run with it.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: And all five equipment slots are yours now: helm, weapon, armor, boots, relic.

Speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
Effective line: The good stuff is rarer, and you can only wear so much of it until you level up. Protocol. Fact: bears do not wear helms. Bears are wiser than us.

Speaker: Fig Sly
When it's heard: Talking to Fig Sly in Crosspath [LOCKED: black market, never changed]
Effective line: You found the chest, so I suppose you've earned a look. Epic and Legendary goods, quiet prices.

Speaker: Fig Sly
When it's heard: Talking to Fig Sly in Crosspath [LOCKED: black market, never changed]
Effective line: {villain}'s tax collectors don't know this stall exists. Let's keep it that way. Shh.

Speaker: Announcer Grand Bellows
When it's heard: Talking to Announcer Grand Bellows in Crosspath (name)
Effective line: The Undercroft

Speaker: Announcer Grand Bellows
When it's heard: Talking to Announcer Grand Bellows in Crosspath (locked)
Effective line: A cellar hatch beside the old cottage, chained shut. Someone has scratched two little crossed swords into the wood.

Speaker: Announcer Grand Bellows
When it's heard: Talking to Announcer Grand Bellows in Crosspath (locked)
Effective line: Whatever is down there is not open for business. Yet.

Speaker: Announcer Grand Bellows
When it's heard: Talking to Announcer Grand Bellows in Crosspath (announce)
Effective line: Word around the square: the abandoned cottage at the end of Champions' Road has started roaring at night.

Speaker: Announcer Grand Bellows
When it's heard: Talking to Announcer Grand Bellows in Crosspath (announce)
Effective line: From the cellar. Somebody brave should check the hatch. Somebody like you.

Speaker: Announcer Grand Bellows
When it's heard: Talking to Announcer Grand Bellows in Crosspath (intro)
Effective line: WELCOME TO THE UNDERCROFT, CHAMPION - ANNOUNCER GRAND BELLOWS, KEEPER OF THE SAND! Mind the third stair; it bites without an introduction.

Speaker: Announcer Grand Bellows
When it's heard: Talking to Announcer Grand Bellows in Crosspath (intro)
Effective line: For a thousand years the four Paths settled their rivalries in the old arena, until {villain} chained the doors. SO WE DUG.

Speaker: Announcer Grand Bellows
When it's heard: Talking to Announcer Grand Bellows in Crosspath (intro)
Effective line: Since you freed a zone, THE RING IS OPEN! Battles and puzzles, tiers one to three, with prizes: ring-exclusive gear, gold, essence!

Speaker: Announcer Grand Bellows
When it's heard: Talking to Announcer Grand Bellows in Crosspath (intro)
Effective line: First clears pay out. Repeats are for GLORY. And for snacks. I brought snacks.

Speaker: (name card)
When it's heard: Boss intro before the battle with Announcer Grand Bellows: title under the name card
Effective line: Voice of the Undercroft

Speaker: Announcer Grand Bellows
When it's heard: Boss intro before the battle with Announcer Grand Bellows: opening line
Effective line: IN THIS CORNER: A CHALLENGER! IN THAT CORNER: ME! (normal voice) Hello.

Speaker: Announcer Grand Bellows
When it's heard: Talking to Announcer Grand Bellows in Crosspath (return)
Effective line: THE SAND IS HOT AND THE CEILING IS LOW! Pick a fight, champion - the crowd is mostly my echo, and he agrees with EVERYTHING!

Speaker: Auntie Alembic
When it's heard: Talking to Auntie Alembic in Crosspath (name)
Effective line: Auntie Alembic's

Speaker: Auntie Alembic
When it's heard: Talking to Auntie Alembic in Crosspath (locked)
Effective line: The door of Auntie Alembic's is bolted. A note is pinned to it in green ink, in what looks like four handwritings at once:

Speaker: Auntie Alembic
When it's heard: Talking to Auntie Alembic in Crosspath (locked)
Effective line: 'CLOSED UNTIL TWO ZONES ARE FREE. {villain} TOOK MY CAULDRON. I AM BREWING IN THE SINK. THE SINK IS COPING. - A.'

Speaker: Auntie Alembic
When it's heard: Talking to Auntie Alembic in Crosspath (announce)
Effective line: With two zones free, a cauldron bubbles to life in {town}. Auntie Alembic's is open! Bring essence. Bring courage. Bring a fire blanket.

Speaker: Auntie Alembic
When it's heard: Talking to Auntie Alembic in Crosspath (intro)
Effective line: Auntie Alembic. Alchemist. Do not touch anything. ...Fine. Touch that one. It likes you.

Speaker: Auntie Alembic
When it's heard: Talking to Auntie Alembic in Crosspath (intro)
Effective line: Whenever you collect more copies of a card than you can carry, the extras turn into essence of that card's Path.

Speaker: Auntie Alembic
When it's heard: Talking to Auntie Alembic in Crosspath (intro)
Effective line: Bring me ALL the essence of two Paths, plus a little gold, and I will brew you a card of BOTH. Random. Unpredictable. Occasionally on fire.

Speaker: Auntie Alembic
When it's heard: Talking to Auntie Alembic in Crosspath (intro)
Effective line: They say there was one spring once, the Wellspring, that fed all four Paths. Everything mixed at the source, dear. That is the kingdom I brew for.

Speaker: Auntie Alembic
When it's heard: Talking to Auntie Alembic in Crosspath (return)
Effective line: Essence of two Paths and a little gold, dear; faith helps with the waiting. Lower your voice around the red flask - it takes things personally.

Speaker: Auntie Alembic
When it's heard: Talking to Auntie Alembic in Crosspath (need more)
Effective line: You do not have enough essence of two different Paths yet. Collect more duplicates, then come back. The cauldron will wait.

Speaker: Auntie Alembic
When it's heard: Talking to Auntie Alembic in Crosspath (need more)
Effective line: The cauldron is patient. Please don't confuse patience with having had lunch.

Speaker: (UI)
Effective line: {villain} rules the four Paths through his rulers. Beat each road's gatekeeper, then free its zone by beating the boss of its main dungeon.

Speaker: (UI)
Effective line: The imperial road to the Capital is open from the start, but its broken services will flatten you. Free the zones first. Gatekeeper Brannoch can explain.

Speaker: (UI)
Effective line: All four Paths are free. Buy cards, test yourself in the Undercroft, and brew something dangerous at the Alchemist's.

Speaker: Announcer Grand Bellows
When it's heard: Talking to Announcer Grand Bellows in Crosspath (unlock line)
Effective line: Something under the old cottage at the end of Champions' Road is open for business. Listen for the crowd.

Speaker: Auntie Alembic
When it's heard: Talking to Auntie Alembic in Crosspath (unlock line)
Effective line: Auntie Alembic's, the Alchemist, is now open in {town}. Bring your leftovers.

Speaker: Foil Fenwick
When it's heard: Talking to Foil Fenwick in Crosspath (name)
Effective line: Foil Fenwick

Speaker: Foil Fenwick
When it's heard: Talking to Foil Fenwick in Crosspath (title)
Effective line: Fenwick's Sealed Goods

Speaker: Foil Fenwick
When it's heard: Talking to Foil Fenwick in Crosspath (first)
Effective line: Psst... hear that crinkle? That's possibility, with excellent packaging.

Speaker: Foil Fenwick
When it's heard: Talking to Foil Fenwick in Crosspath (first)
Effective line: Foil Fenwick, Purveyor of Sealed Goods - packs only. Open one where the light's good; if I cry, I want to see what I'm crying about.

Speaker: Foil Fenwick
When it's heard: Talking to Foil Fenwick in Crosspath (first)
Effective line: How it works: whenever a Path's final dungeon falls, that Path sends me its pack. Don't ask how. Lots of foil, no paperwork. The Necrocrats find it upsetting.
